blocks.x: Non-revenue water down 21% — district metering to decision loop
A national water utility, Energy & Utilities sector, outcome-linked engagement, blended delivery team. Figures are the client's own, shared with permission.
Leakage unlocated; district metering sparse; repairs reactive.
Field operations by phone; routing inefficient. Billing disputes from meter-to-bill errors.

District metering fabric (flow/pressure/quality with governance) feeds leak-location analytics on Forge; work-order orchestration routes crews by skills and proximity; and the meter-to-bill pipeline with anomaly detection collapsed dispute volume.

blocks.x: What would change in your estate

Two things from the national water utility program generalize — the governance shape and the gate design. Everything else was estate-specific, and pretending otherwise is how programs waste their first quarter The engagement model here was build-transfer; the same pattern runs fixed-scope where the estate allows it.
Figures on this page are the client's, reproduced with permission. Method notes and measurement designs are available under NDA.
